noun_definition: Expense refers to a financial charge submitted by a user in a report, which in this context exceeds a specified amount of $200 and is subject to tax regulations.

Violation message refers to the notification displayed to the user indicating that the submitted expense exceeds the allowed amount, which is expected to include the exceeding amount but currently shows as undefined when taxes are enabled.
Amount refers to the total dollar value of the submitted expense that exceeds the specified limit, which is expected to be displayed in the violation message.
Tax refers to a financial charge applied to expenses within a collective policy that, when enabled, should affect the displayed violation message related to exceeding amounts.
